import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Subgroup.Basic
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Subgroup.DerivedSeries
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Factorial.Basic

theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with n ih generalizing H

    constructor
    · exact H.normal_of_subgroup
    · exact Subgroup.subset_subgroup H
    · exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    · exact Nat.le_refl 1
  · -- Inductive step

    have hn_lt : ∀ m, m < n → ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ m.factorial
    · intro m hm
      have hm_pos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_lt hm
      have hm_lt : m < n := hm
      have hH' : H.index = m := by linarith [hH]
      exact ih m hm_pos H hH'
    have h_derived_series : ∃ K : Subgroup G, K ≤ H ∧ K.Normal ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial
    · let derived_series := H.derivedSeries
      have h_derived_series_length : derived_series.length ≤ n.factorial
      · sorry
      have h_derived_series_normal : ∀ i, derived_series[i].Normal
      · sorry
      have h_derived_series_subset : ∀ i, derived_series[i] ≤ H
      · sorry
      have h_derived_series_index : ∀ i, derived_series[i].index ≤ n.factorial
      · sorry
      let K := derived_series[n.factorial]
      use K
      constructor
      · exact h_derived_series_normal n.factorial
      · exact h_derived_series_subset n.factorial
      · exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      · exact h_derived_series_index n.factorial
